channel.title: Newsical
channel.description: Newsical is a teen-friendly, lightly satirical musical recap of the day's most important world and U.S. news, released weekday mornings in time for the drive to school. Each episode turns a handful of real stories into short original songs and character scenes: what happened, why it matters, and what is still uncertain. Stories are researched and fact-checked against a published source ledger with links, and every episode page includes that ledger and a transcript. Coverage aims to be accurate and nonpartisan; the jokes aim at bureaucracy and absurdity, never at people in danger. AI disclosure: the music, singing and spoken voices in this show are generated by AI models, and the scripts are written with AI assistance; no real person's voice is imitated.

channel.itunes:subtitle: The day's world and U.S. news, sung. A satirical musical recap for teens.

item.title: Friday, Oct 2, 2026: U.S. wraps up its counter-IS troop mission in Iraq; Pentagon cuts top brass; Morocco's first woman prime minister; Tokyo's 35-day rain streak; Costume records at the Berlin Marathon
item.description:
U.S. forces complete their withdrawal from Iraq's counter-Islamic State mission; the Pentagon orders a 20% cut in general and admiral positions; Morocco's king appoints the country's first woman prime minister, who now has to build a coalition; central Tokyo breaks its record with 35 straight days of rain; and Guinness World Records certifies costume records at the Berlin Marathon.
The music, singing and spoken voices in this episode are AI-generated; the script was written with AI assistance and checked against the linked sources.
